verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major finding. The design record now explicitly replaces the unsound reduced-value MAC recomputation with the implementation's independent input-MAC construction, derives the coordinated-deviation check equation, rejects the former route, and retains the research-grade/no-external-audit caveat. The added test exercises value-only, MAC-only, and both-reduction deviations through the production carry construction and confirms that the resulting consistent degree-t codewords evade Reed-Solomon checking but fail the MAC check. The documentation and code now agree on the load-bearing invariant. No blocker or major correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue remains in the diff.
